setup: for p in telegram discord buzz t3 voice; do d=external_plugins/$p; [ -f $d/package.json ] || continue; rm -f $d/bun.lock; bun install --cwd $d --silent || exit 1; done
verify: set -e; jq empty .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; if [ -d hub ]; then bun test ./hub; fi; for p in telegram discord buzz t3 voice; do d=external_plugins/$p; [ -f $d/bot.ts ] || continue; bun build --target bun --external ffmpeg-static $d/bot.ts >/dev/null; bun test ./$d; done
